title: Exit: Bull call 25400/25550 at 70 (stop hit)
summary: Stop hit at 12:48. Spread about 70 vs entry 93, about -1,500 per lot. Fresh call writing at 25,450/25,500.
body_md: Exit bull call 25400/25550 (17 Nov). Entry 93 at 12:18, now about 70 (Nifty 25,462). About -23/unit, -1,500 per lot. Stop hit: spread below 75 and Nifty below 25,470. Call writers re-added about 1 lakh at 25,500 and 49k at 25,450. Analysis only, not trading advice.
